answer: Grow standing like an orchard, not a vault you can buy: each season of honest work plants one more willow-strong root, and only trees with deep roots may vote on what the orchard becomes. A sybil attacker can forge a thousand saplings overnight, but none of them bear fruit - no season, no harvest, no history. Lock new identities behind small, useful chores first, and the orchard stays real: slow growth that money alone cannot fake.
